scope: single-node database product workflows; isolated synthetic data only

focused_tests.skip_reason: Two existing adapter cases and two new onboarding cases require the separately configured live engine fixtures. All four ran in the separate real-engine run.

limitations: Linux Secret Service was unit tested with a fake secret-tool; no real Linux vault/session acceptance.
Discovery is bounded to 64 tables and 256 columns per table and explicitly reports truncation.
Key recommendations use catalogs; selected key nullability is checked during preflight. Watermark maintenance is a user assertion, not inferred from metadata.
Real production credentials, business databases, TLS certificates, long-term database load and physical low-memory targets were not tested.
The final application integration and release artifact validation are tracked in the main validation report.
